source.title: Michael Pinsky - All the Tyres from Iceland (Waag Futurelab, S+T+ARTS4WaterII)
source.description: All the Tyres from Iceland is a sculptural and film-based project developed by artist Michael Pinsky during the S+T+ARTS4WaterII residency in Amsterdam. The work explores the international trade in waste materials, focusing on the journey of tyres from Iceland to GRANUBAND, a tyre recycling company based in the Port of Amsterdam. More information: https://www.waag.org/nl/project/starts4waterii/ Construction: Leoke Weldingworks Video production: Leandra Hoffmann r3mediacontent Exhibition cultural partner: Stichting NDSM-werf With material and logistic support by: Granuband Supported by: Port of Amsterdam and Waag Futurelab S+T+ARTS4WaterII is funded by the European Union under grant agreement LC-02629312 under the S+T+ARTS – Science, Technology and Arts initiative of DG CNECT.
